predictions.title: GPTSCAN-PM-001: Manipulable Price Used in a Financial Operation
predictions.description: A financial operation depends on a price or valuation derived from potentially attacker-influenceable market or protocol state without sufficient manipulation-resistant validation.
predictions.impact: Manipulating the pricing input may distort asset valuation or financial operation amounts, potentially causing excessive borrowing, incorrect payouts or liquidation losses. Actual exploitability and loss require further verification.
predictions.mitigation: Use an appropriate manipulation-resistant oracle or validated time-weighted price, validate freshness and deviation where applicable, and ensure financial operations cannot rely on transient attacker-controlled state.
predictions.report_basis: rule-template; not an LLM-generated exploit proof
